questions: Which two scenes could make an application incomplete?
What paperwork has taken you more than one visit?
Is a bad scan or the wrong photo harder to notice?
Why do different applications need different formats?
If a deadline is missed, what chance is lost?
What could you try in 7 days for at most 1,500 BDT? Who might pay if it worked?

starter_experiment.pilot: Ask ten applicants to walk through one real checklist using their own documents; retain no copies.
starter_experiment.test_metric: Missing documents, rejected scans, and time lost before deadlines
starter_experiment.note: Optional cash ceiling for a first experiment, not money required to begin or a full launch budget. Start with tools and relationships already available; pay partners fairly and account for founder time before scaling.

evidence.editor_note: The prospectus is one example of detailed document requirements, not a Rajshahi job posting.
